title.narrative: To contribute to achieving Vision 2030 through universal access to comprehensive HIV prevention, treatment and care - Kenya (01-Jul-2024-30-Jun-2027)

description.narrative: Kenya, HIV, Kenya Red Cross Society (KRCS)This program has the following goals: To provide comprehensive HIV prevention, Treatment, Care and Support towards Universal Health Coverage for all people in Kenya. The objectives of this program are: To reduce new HIV infections by 75%. To reduce AIDS-related mortality by 50%. To micro-eliminate viral hepatitis and reduce the incidence of sexually transmitted infections. To reduce HIV related stigma and discrimination to less than 25%
